plugin.name: 🪎 Schatzsuche
plugin.description: A treasure hunt for your notes: instant search in the sidebar, quick-search buttons, filters by date, heading, folder and task state, a collecting box (Schatzkiste) to save picked results as Markdown, and optional Raindrop.io bookmarks. English and German.
plugin.author: Jörg Oyen

plugin.commands.name: Schatzsuche
plugin.commands.description: Open the Schatzsuche (treasure hunt) search view

plugin.settings.title: Language / Sprache
plugin.settings.description: auto: follows your system language. / auto: folgt der Systemsprache.

plugin.settings.title: Treasure tag / Schatz-Tag
plugin.settings.description: The tag you use to mark treasures, used by two quick-search buttons. / Der Tag, mit dem du Schätze markierst; für zwei Schnellsuchen.

plugin.settings.title: Raindrop token
plugin.settings.description: Test token from app.raindrop.io › Settings › Integrations › your app. Read only. Leave empty to switch Raindrop off. / Test-Token aus app.raindrop.io › Settings › Integrations. Nur lesen. Leer lassen: Raindrop aus.
